text:
sophie: Quick check: about to push annotated tag for v1.12.0-rc.1 — need someone to watch GH release publish. I saw artifact checksums mismatch last time. Will push tag in ~10m. cc @ajay @maria
ajay: On it. Do we have the final changelog entry? I fixed the cli bump earlier.
sophie: Yep changelog ready in PR #2045, merged. Tag message should include migration note about config keys. Draft tag body:
```
Release v1.12.0-rc.1
- Changelog: include config migration note
- Notes: break change for config.foo -> config.bar
```
maria: Heads up: CI shows one artifact name changed from `linux-x86.tar.gz` to `linux-amd64.tar.gz` in the build job. Could cause checksum mismatch.
tom: If that's true we need to update release artifact manifest before pushing tag. I can run a quick rebuild.
ajay: Can you hold until I kick a release pipeline? Also FYI when publishing draft release, GH sometimes prompts for 2FA for browser action — release-bot should be able to publish via API.
ci-bot: ci-bot: build #482 completed — artifacts: linux-amd64.tar.gz, arm64.tar.gz. Checksums: sha256:abc123...
sophie: Ok I'll wait 12m. @tom can you rebuild with canonical artifact name `linux-x86.tar.gz`? If not, we'll update manifest.
tom: Rebuild started: `./scripts/build-release --tag v1.12.0-rc.1 --artifact-name linux-x86.tar.gz`
release-bot: release-bot: reminder: when creating annotated tags, include CHANGELOG entries and migration notes. Use `git tag -a v1.12.0-rc.1 -F tagmsg.txt` then `git push origin v1.12.0-rc.1`
ajay: If rebuild takes too long, I'll just update manifest and set checksums. Sophie, when you push tag, ping me to run the publish script so I can use token (no 2FA).
sophie: Got it. If rebuild finishes within 10m, proceed with canonical artifacts. Otherwise manifest update + note. I'll push annotated tag after we confirm artifact names. ETA 15m.
tom: Rebuild done + checksum: sha256:def456.... Uploaded to gcs://redwood-release/v1.12.0-rc.1/
sophie: Confirmed artifact names match. Pushing tag now. Pinging @ajay when done.
ajay: Standing by. :thumbsup:
